claims: Mason Miller is a relief pitcher for Team USA in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Mason Miller serves as a closer for Team USA in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Mason Miller made his Team USA debut in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Mason Miller is a right-hander from the Oakland Athletics.
Mason Miller closed out games against Canada and Brazil for Team USA in the 2026 World Baseball Classic to advance to the semifinals.
Miller secured a win over Canada on March 13 by pitching a perfect 9th inning with three strikeouts to win 5-3, as reported by MLB.com and Instagram.
Miller secured the victory over Brazil on March 6 by striking out the side in the 9th, ensuring Team USA’s place in the semifinals, according to Instagram and YouTube.
Mason Miller made his 2023 MLB debut.
Mason Miller had a 2.63 ERA in 2024, notes USA Baseball.
Mason Miller had 104 strikeouts in 2024, notes USA Baseball.
There is also a young prospect named Aidan Miller in the USA Baseball system.
Mason Miller is the pitcher for the 2026 WBC team, confirms USA Baseball.
